title: I installed Linux (so should you)
summary: PewDiePie describes switching to Linux and encourages viewers to do the same. It is a casual, enthusiastic video aimed at a mainstream audience.
why: HN mentions it as a sign of Linux reaching millions of non-technical viewers, with some finding it funny and others fascinating.

quote.text: Try PewDiePie. around 6.7M people now know something like Linux and Hyprland exists
